match.userMessage: Please don't use bullet points with me — just write in plain sentences.

response.content: Understood, I'll stick to plain prose from now on. To redo that last answer briefly: beyond bacalhau, you might try bacalhau à Brás (shredded salt cod with egg and potato), grilled sardines, clams in garlic and coriander, octopus roasted with olive oil, and a good pastel de nata from a proper local bakery rather than a touristy one. Happy to suggest specific restaurants for any of these whenever you like.
